description: Jelly Operator overview and cell calculations for the unchanged latest real save. Offline snapshot research is paired by input inspection; XP per landed hit explicitly applies the Cell Biology gate from JellyOperation/CanLvUpUnits and hit caller 290704. Daily allowance uses Research Grid_Bonus 186 mode 1, not its percentage bonus.
target: Jelly Operator presentation calculations and direct parameters

extractions.label: jelly_daily_allowance
extractions.description: Daily attempt allowance, independent of saved attempts remaining.

extractions.label: jelly_current_target_hp
extractions.description: Current obstruction HP at the real cleared-obstruction index; this save exercises the post-intro exponential curve.

extractions.label: jelly_current_time_limit
extractions.description: Current obstruction time allowance at the real group progression.

extractions.label: jelly_dps_bloodcell_multiplier
extractions.description: Permanent Bloodcell multiplier from best recorded DPS; also a direct CurrencyMulti parameter.

extractions.label: jelly_daily_bloodcells
extractions.description: Automatic daily login Bloodcells based on the best single operation and Daily Transfusion.

extractions.label: jelly_xp_per_hit
extractions.description: Actual XP per landed hit. Raw EXPMulti has an ungated base value, but the hit caller awards XP only with Cell Biology unlocked.
